description: This file defines the 'Roadmap' React component, which renders a detailed project roadmap page with timelines, sections, and feature highlights. It includes various sub-components for timeline items, markers, content sections, and a list of upcoming features.

methods.name: TimelineItem
methods.description: A React component that provides a relative-positioned container for timeline entries.

methods.name: TimelineMarker
methods.description: A React component that renders a visual marker (styled circle and dashed line) for timeline points.

methods.name: TimelineWeAreHere
methods.description: A React component that displays a 'We are here!' indicator with an arrow, positioned based on viewport size.

methods.name: TimelineContent
methods.description: A React component displaying a titled content block with highlighting, used within the timeline.

methods.name: RoadmapList
methods.description: A React component that renders a responsive grid list, typically for roadmap items.

methods.name: RoadmapItem
methods.description: A React component representing an individual item in the roadmap, optionally marked as released and categorized by section.

methods.name: Divider
methods.description: A simple styled horizontal divider used to separate sections.
